creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Google's Antigravity replaces Gemini CLI as the agent to target on that side.

First find out what Antigravity reads and where: its equivalents of a global instructions file, rules, skills or workflows, subagents, hooks, MCP config, and whether any of them are per-project vs global. Then decide which tai asset types map onto it and which have no equivalent (those should be skipped with a warning, as other targets do).

Then add an adapter alongside claude/codex/opencode, a target name, docs, and tests. Worth reusing whatever the gemini adapter got right before it is removed - check its git history rather than resurrecting it wholesale.
title: Add Antigravity as an install target
